- The marks are not decorative; they form a directed operative power-transfer link. Scarlett can (and does) feed strength and cognitive recovery to Benjamin at visible cost to herself (she grows visibly weaker with each absence; tattoo on his neck flashes white-hot like an ember when she leaves). After her collapse following the GT Black Series send-off, conventional medicine exhausted; next step is controlled power transfer from a different ancient mark/donor source (50/50 survival odds for her). She extracts promise from Dr. Elias Berg that Benjamin must not know the supernatural truth — it must look like pure medical intervention only.

**Current-canon warning:** The full Inanna/Dumuzid cycle as justification tied to operative behaviour, the unilateral extraction and “you’re with me, end of story” framing, and the supernatural power economics must be treated as historical or mode-specific.
